summary.text: Gerald "Tap" Heikes is a Republican who has run in several Alaska elections, including the 2014 Republican primary for governor. He placed fifth, with 1% of the vote, in the August 2026 top-four primary and advanced to the general election after David Leslie withdrew.

paragraphs.text: Gerald Heikes sought the Republican nomination for Alaska governor in the August 19, 2014 primary, in which incumbent Sean Parnell defeated him and two other challengers.

Heikes has also appeared on Alaska ballots for the U.S. House at-large seat, including as a write-in candidate in 2020, according to Ballotpedia, which notes he did not complete its Candidate Connection survey in 2020.
In the August 18, 2026 U.S. Senate top-four primary he received 1% of the vote, and he advanced to the general election when fourth-place finisher David Leslie withdrew before the Aug. 31 deadline.
